resources.string: Tap to continue a task handed to ClosePaw while Shelly was in the background
%1$s\n\nTap to open ClosePaw. ClosePaw asks you to confirm Run before it does anything.
Shelly: approve a ClosePaw task from the terminal

%1$s\n\nRequested from the terminal (e.g. Codex / ChatGPT). Your Shelly-trusted ClosePaw build will run it without asking again, so approve only if you want this. ClosePaw's result will be returned to the terminal (e.g. Codex / ChatGPT). Goal hash %2$s. Expires in 10 minutes.
Approved — ClosePaw is running in the background
Approved — ClosePaw is controlling the screen
Rejected — nothing was sent to ClosePaw
This request was already decided or has expired
Unlock your phone, then tap Approve again
